normative_evidence.scope: Communication and order/state behavior between fleet control and mobile robots
normative_evidence.explicitly_out_of_scope: Functional, operational and system safety requirements; the document is not a safety standard
normative_evidence.rmos_use_boundary: May inform order cancellation and state-reporting semantics only. cancelOrder asks the robot to attempt to stop; non-cancellable actions may finish and report FINISHED when successful or FAILED when unsuccessful. It must not be inserted into a physical emergency-stop chain or treated as proof that a safety stop occurred.
uncertain_fields: Applicability to each future robot model

supported_atomic_facts: Order cancellation is a protocol operation
Uncancellable actions may continue to completion
Successful uncancellable action may report FINISHED
withdrawn_conclusions: C-0 as an emergency-stop minimum correct model
all cancelled actions explicitly report FAILED

failure_modes: Waiting for protocol acknowledgement before safety action
Assuming every affected action becomes FAILED
rmos_decision_fields.exit_strategy: Use applicable machinery/robot safety standards and manufacturer safety interfaces
alternative_candidates: OPC UA for Robotics state model
